title: Pharmacy Benefit Management Consulting Services
agency_path: City of New York > NYC Health + Hospitals
submit_to: 50 Water Street, 7th Floor, New York, NY 10004
description_text: MetroPlusHealth is seeking consultant services specializing in Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM), to provide strategic, operational, financial, clinical, and regulatory expertise related to both pharmacy benefit and medical benefit drug management programs.The selected vendor will support MetroPlusHealths evaluation, optimization, oversight, and long-term strategic planning of pharmacy and provider-administered drug benefits across all lines of business.The selected vendor will serve as a strategic advisor to MetroPlusHealth providing independent expertise and analysis to support informed decision-making, effective vendor oversight, and the continued optimization of pharmacy and medical drug benefit programs.
